verdict.rationale: HumanLayer orchestrates coding-agent tasks, so a repository agent-readiness report is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never documents such a report or assessment. Workspace configuration and usage/cost metrics are adjacent features, not an evaluation of how ready a repository is for autonomous agents.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can run a readiness report that evaluates how ready my repository is for autonomous agents
